parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law for connected particles (truck) in a straight line
parts.reason: Straight-line motion with resolved forces on a truck; M8.2/M8.4 cover connected particle problems with resistances and tension.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Newton's second law for whole system / trailer
parts.reason: Same connected-particle context as (a), covered by M8.4 guidance on connected particles.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Explaining inextensible string/tow bar implies equal acceleration
parts.reason: Conceptual point directly tied to M8.4 connected particles (light inextensible tow bar), no excluded content.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Impulse-momentum and Newton's Experimental Law style collision
parts.reason: 'Impulse' is explicitly listed as a concept no 9MA0 statement covers, and this uses impulse=change in momentum for a collision, which is not part of any M-section statement (momentum/collisions not mentioned).

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Impulse-momentum for collision
parts.reason: Same as (a): relies on impulse and momentum conservation in a collision, concept not covered by any statement.

parts.label: main
parts.technique: Equilibrium of a particle on rough ground with friction, resolving forces
parts.reason: Particle in equilibrium with tension inclined to ground, friction F≤μR model; matches M8.6 (friction) combined with M8.1/8.4 (equilibrium, resolving forces).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: suvat: constant acceleration under gravity, vertical motion
parts.reason: Standard use of suvat formulae for vertical motion under gravity, covered by M7.3.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: suvat: time of flight for vertical projectile motion
parts.reason: Uses constant acceleration formulae for straight-line vertical motion, within M7.3.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Velocity-time graph for straight-line motion under gravity
parts.reason: Sketching v-t graph with gradient/intercept interpretation directly matches M7.2.

parts.label: a(i)
parts.technique: Moments - taking moments about a point for a rod in equilibrium
parts.reason: Non-uniform rod suspended by strings, taking moments; matches M9.1 (equilibrium in simple static contexts).

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.technique: Moments about the other end
parts.reason: Same moments technique as (i), within M9.1.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Solving inequalities derived from moments expressions for tension limits
parts.reason: Uses results from (a) (moments) combined with linear inequality solving, both in spec (M9.1 and P2.5-type inequality manipulation).

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Distance between two points given as position vectors
parts.reason: Direct use of position vectors and magnitude/distance formula, covered by P10.4.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Position vector as function of time for constant velocity
parts.reason: Standard use of vectors in kinematics (r = r0 + vt), covered by M7.3 extension to 2D vectors.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Position vector as function of time for constant velocity
parts.reason: Same technique as (b).

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Equating vector position expressions component-wise to find meeting time
parts.reason: This resembles finding intersection of two lines by equating vector expressions - the syllabus excludes 'intersection of lines' as a vector concept, but here it is presented as a kinematics/relative motion problem (two ships meeting), which is standard M7.3 vector kinematics rather than pure vector geometry line intersection; borderline since method is identical to line intersection.

parts.label: e
parts.technique: Finding position vector at a given time using found t
parts.reason: Substitution into position vector expression, consistent with M7.3/P10 vector work.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: Newton's second law for particle P on table with friction, connected via string
parts.reason: Equation of motion for connected particle on rough table with tension and friction; matches M8.4/M8.6.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Newton's second law for particle Q on inclined plane connected via pulley
parts.reason: Connected particles over pulley with one on inclined plane, explicitly covered by M8.4 guidance (forces need to be resolved e.g. at least one particle on inclined plane).

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Solving simultaneous equations of motion for acceleration and tension, with friction model
parts.reason: Combines M8.2/M8.4 connected particles and M8.6 friction model F≤μR, solving for a and T.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: suvat after string breaks: finding speed, deceleration due to friction, and distance
parts.reason: Uses v²=u²+2as for constant acceleration, then Newton's second law with friction to find deceleration and further suvat application; matches M7.3 and M8.6.
